text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While passing by a ramen shop one
day...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, sir! We've got this!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Time to help out like I've never
helped out
before!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The owner of this ramen shop hurt his
back, so
Tsuru and I have decided to
help him!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to drag you two into this. You
Tracen
students are all such good eggs.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I'll handle the dishes, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll take out the trash in the
meantime!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That's it for the trash. I wonder
how Tsuru
is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru, what's wrong?! Why do you look
so
exhausted?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... I-I washed... the pot... a little too vigorously... and started feeling out of breath...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Sorry... I just need... a little break... Urk.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you like that. I'm okay
now,
though! Time to get back to those
dishes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! But what if you faint again?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! But what if you faint again?!
choice_data_list: I'll teach you the trick to doing ...
How about switching over to custom...
Why not try switching to customer ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Dishwashing tricks?
choice_data_list: I'll teach you the trick to doing ...
How about switching over to custom...
Why not try switching to customer ...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! If you know how to wash
them
efficiently, then you won't risk
overexerting
yourself again!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense! Right! I'm all ears,
then!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I feel like I've gotten it down now.
Time to
get washing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Take this, and this, and this, and this!
NEXT!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: HAAARGH! Let me at that next pot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze! Puff! H-huh? I'm starting to feel tired again...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru! I think you'd better slow down a
little!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she tries to hold back,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi keeps going overboard.
However, she somehow
manages to help out until
the end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Dealing with customers is definitely
less taxing on the body! I'll take care of
the dishes,
Tsuru, so go ahead and
handle the customers!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Sorry for causing so much
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I won't let your kindness go to waste,
though!
Time to help some customers!
Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: WELCOOOME! Cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: One order of soy sauce ramen, STAT! Cough, cough! Hack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a few shaky moments even while
serving the customers, but Tsurumaru
Tsuyoshi is able to
finish helping out
until the end.
